bug_semantics: Stored XSS (CWE-79) in FluentCMS File Management: FileController.Upload accepts any IFormFile with no SVG sanitization and no server-side extension allowlist, copying the client Content-Type (including image/svg+xml) onto the File entity. FileService.Create persists the raw stream via IFileStorageProvider.Upload. FileController.Download then returns Results.File(..., contentType: file.ContentType). RemoteFileProviderMiddleware on public /files/{id} copies that Content-Type onto the unauthenticated response and streams the body without Content-Disposition: attachment or CSP, so an SVG containing <script>, on* handlers, or javascript: URIs executes in any browser that opens the uploaded file URL.
flaw_origin: The persist-unsanitized-upload plus client-MIME serve path was first written in reconstructable PR #1695 member 0fdb790520a55b89f762babd97dc2765b6295411 (#1694 add file provider and configuration) by Amir Pournasserian: FileService.Create stored formFile.OpenReadStream() unchanged, recorded MimeType = formFile.ContentType, and FileController.Download served Results.File with that MIME type. Immediate parent 378d00ebb832f009dec415e2b8c511d1bc36f249 only had a throwaway temp-file Upload stub and metadata-only Create (no IFileStorageProvider, no Download). Squash 991595d2d0d342340b58a907c64ec23207199556 landed the File/Stream rewrite (FileService blob-identical to member 01e0e9a5720d8aa96fe838c3fb04fb6822dd3516) on origin/dev. Later #2216/9517ad5a added RemoteFileProviderMiddleware (member a80bdcf62f7c4e03763c3d35cc2ac535fef17148) that serves /files inline; that is an expanded sink, not the first write of missing sanitization.

potential_fix.approach: In FileService.Create, detect SVG by extension/content-type and sanitize before fileRepository.Create/fileStorageProvider.Upload (strip script/foreignObject, on* handlers, and javascript:/vbscript:/data: URL attributes), and/or serve SVG with Content-Disposition: attachment plus a restrictive CSP instead of inline image/svg+xml.
potential_fix.rationale: Sanitizing or neutralizing SVG before it is stored and before RemoteFileProviderMiddleware replays image/svg+xml without attachment disposition removes the executable payload from the public file URL that the advisory exploits.
